## Factory Calendar

Path: `/production/factoryCalendar?Year={Year}`
The Factory Calendar resource allows Factory Calendar to be viewed, created, and updated.

### Available Fields for FactoryCalendar
| Property | Type           | Length | Required |Notes       |
|:-------|----------------------|---------|----------|----------|
| `Year`  | Short           |         | Yes |         |
| `WeekStart`  | String             | 50        | Yes* | Required for POST. Possible values are <a href="#DayOfWeekList"><b>values</b></a>.|
| `FactoryCalendarDays`  | Array             |         |    Yes*  | Required for POST. There should be data for each days in a week (7 items). |
| `FactoryCalendarSpecialDays`  | Array             |         |          | Data will be deleted if received collection is empty. |

### Available Fields for FactoryCalendarDay
| Property | Type           | Length | Required |Notes       |
|:-------|----------------------|---------|----------|----------|
| `DayOfWeek`  | String           |         | Yes |    Possible values are <a href="#DayOfWeekList"><b>values</b></a>.     |
| `IsWeekend`  | Bool             |         |  | Default false |
| `StartTime`  | Short             |         |    Yes  | In minutes. Should be in the range 0 - 1440 (from 0 minutes to 24h*60m). |
| `EndTime`  | Short             |         |    Yes  | In minutes. Should be in the range 0 - 1440 (from 0 minutes to 24h*60m). |
| `BreakStartTime`  | Short             |         |      | In minutes. Should be in the range 0 - 1440 (from 0 minutes to 24h*60m). |
| `BreakEndTime`  | Short             |         |      | In minutes. Should be in the range 0 - 1440 (from 0 minutes to 24h*60m). |
| `Capacity`  | Int             |         |          | Readonly. |

### Available Fields for FactoryCalendarSpecialDay
| Property | Type           | Length | Required |Notes       |
|:-------|----------------------|---------|----------|----------|
| `Date`  | DateTime           |         | Yes |    Must fall within the current factory calendar year.    |
| `IsWeekend`  | Bool             |         |  | Default false |
| `IsHoliday`  | Bool             |         |  | Default false |
| `StartTime`  | Short             |         |      | In minutes. Should be in the range 0 - 1440 (from 0 minutes to 24h*60m). |
| `EndTime`  | Short             |         |      | In minutes. Should be in the range 0 - 1440 (from 0 minutes to 24h*60m). |
| `BreakStartTime`  | Short             |         |      | In minutes. Should be in the range 0 - 1440 (from 0 minutes to 24h*60m). |
| `BreakEndTime`  | Short             |         |      | In minutes. Should be in the range 0 - 1440 (from 0 minutes to 24h*60m). |
| `Capacity`  | Int             |         |          | Readonly. |
| `Comment`  | String             |  512       |          |  |

<a id="put-production-factorycalendar"></a>
### PUT /production/factoryCalendar
+ FactoryCalendarDays, FactoryCalendarSpecialDays do not support modifying. Only creation and deletion are supported.
+ FactoryCalendarDays will only be overwritten when collection is not empty.
+ FactoryCalendarSpecialDays will be overwritten even when collection is empty.

## Product Production BOM

Path: `/production/productionBOM`
The Production BOM resource allows Production BOMs to be listed, viewed, created, and updated for specified Products.

### Available Fields for Production BOM <a id="ProductionBOM"></a>
|Property|Type|Length|Required|Notes|
|:-------|----|------|--------|-----|
|`BOMID`|Guid||Yes when updating|Identifier of a Production BOM.|
|`OutputQuantity`|Decimal||Yes||
|`BufferPercent`|Decimal||Yes||
|`InstructionUrl`|String||||
|`IgnoreCumulativeLeadTime`|Bool|||Default = false|
|`ComponentProductionLeadTime`|Integer|||Required when IgnoreCumulativeLeadTime is set to 'true'. Default = 0.|
|`Version`|Integer||Yes||
|`Name`|String|256|Yes||
|`IsDefault`|Bool||Yes||
|`IsTracing`|Bool||No||
|`DeliveryToID`|Guid|||Location: Bin / Location.|
|`DeliveryToName`|String|256|||
|`IssueMethod`|String|||Readonly, can be Manual = 1, DerivedFromProductFamily = 3, ExternalApi = 4.|
|`Operations`|<a href="#ProductionBOMOperation"><b>[] Operation Model</b></a>||||
|`IssueMethodComponent`|String|||Can be Manual = 1, Backflush = 2|
|`IssueMethodParameter`|String|||Ignored when IssueMethodComponent = Manual. Possible values: BackflushForBOM = 1, BackflushForOperation = 2, BackflushForComponent = 3 |
|`MinQuantity`        | Decimal    |           |    No       | Minimum Quantity to Produce Per Production Order defines the minimum quantity threshold to initiate the Production Order creation. If this quantity is not met, Production Order is not created automatically based on the Sales Order.|
|`MaxQuantity`        | Decimal    |           |    No       | Maximum Quantity to Produce Per Production Order defines the maximum quantity threshold to split the Production Order while creating. If this quantity is met, Production Order is split into several Production Orders based on Max Quantity To Produce Per Production Order.|
|`DeviationPercent`        | Decimal    |           |    No       | Order Quantity Deviation % defines the deviation from Min/Max Quantity to Produce Per Production Order. If Order Quantity Deviation % is set to 0, the Min/Max Quantity to Produce Per Production Order is a fixed quantity.|
|`RunSize`        | Decimal    |           |    No       | Run Size defines the multiplicity factor for Production Run.|

### Available Fields for Production BOM Operation Type <a id="ProductionBOMOperationType"></a>
|Operation Type|
|:-------|
|Manufacturing|
|Setup|
|QA|
|CoManufacturing|

|`AttachmentID`|Guid||Yes when updating|Identifier of a Production BOM Attachment.|
|`FileName`|String|256|||
|`Date`|DateTime|||Readonly|
|`ContentType`|String||Yes||
|`Content`|String||Yes|Base64 string of binary file content.|
|`Position`|Integer||Yes||

### Available Fields for Production BOM Note <a id="ProductionBOMNote"></a>
|Property|Type|Length|Required|Notes|
|:-------|----|------|--------|-----|
|`NoteID`|Guid||Yes when updating|Identifier of a Production BOM Note.|
|`Note`|String|4000||Yes|
|`Position`|Integer||Yes||

### Available Fields for Production BOM Operation Link <a id="ProductionBOMOperationLink"></a>
|Property|Type|Length|Required|Notes|
|:-------|----|------|--------|-----|
|`ID`|Guid||Yes when updating|Identifier of a Production BOM Operation Link.|
|`RelatedOperationID`|Guid||Yes when RelatedOperationName is not set.||
|`RelatedOperationName`|String|200|Yes when RelatedOperationID is not set.||
|`RelationType`|Integer|0+|Yes|Possible value: 1|

### Available Fields for Production BOM InputProducts, OutputProducts, FinishedProducts <a id="ProductionBOMOperationProduct"></a>
|Property|Type|Length|Required|Notes|
|:-------|----|------|--------|-----|
|`ID`|Guid||Yes when updating|Identifier of a Production BOM Operation Product.|
|`ProductID`|Guid||Yes when ProductSKU is not set.||
|`ProductSKU`|String||Yes when ProductID is not set.||
|`ProductName`|String|||Readonly|
|`CostCalculationType`|String||Yes|Can be None. If BOM contains several finished products, should contain SalesValue or Nrv.|
|`PriceTier`|Integer|1 - 10|||
|`Ratio`|Decimal|0 - 100|||
|`OutputQuantity`|Decimal|0+|Yes||
|`Position`|Integer||Yes||
|`CostingMethod`|String|||Readonly.|
|`Unit`|String|||Readonly|
|`AverageCost`|Decimal|||Readonly|
|`WastageCost`|Integer||||
|`DeliveryTo`|Guid|||DeliveryTo location identifier. |
|`DeliveryToName`|String|256||DeliveryTo location name.|

<a id="delete-production-productionbom-product-production-bom"></a>
### DELETE /production/productionBOM?ProductID={ProductID}&BOMID={BOMID}
+ Method will delete specified Production BOM of specified product.

Parameters:
- `ProductID` (required, guid): Identifier of the Product whose Production BOMs will be deleted
- `BOMID` (required, guid): Identifier of a Product BOM to be deleted

Response 204:

```json
(no body)
```

## Product Family Production BOM

Path: `/production/productionBOM/`
The Production BOM resource allows Production BOMs to be listed, viewed, created, and updated for specified Product Families.
It uses the same models as those of Product Production BOMs, except for the models that are listed below.

### Available Fields for Production BOM
See <a href="#ProductionBOM"><b>Production BOM Model</b></a>. The only difference is that fields 'Version', 'Name', 'IsDefault' are currently readonly.

### Available Fields for Production BOM Operation
See <a href="#ProductionBOMOperation"><b>Production BOM Operation Model</b></a>
Additional fields:
|Property|Type|Length|Required|Notes|
|:-------|----|------|--------|-----|
|`VariationComponents`|<a href="#ProductionBOMVariationComponent"><b>[] Variation Component Model</b></a>||||

### Available Fields for Production BOM Variation Component <a id="ProductionBOMVariationComponent"></a>
|Property|Type|Length|Required|Notes|
|:-------|----|------|--------|-----|
|`BOMVariationComponentID`|Guid||Yes when updating|Identifier of a Production BOM Variation Component.|
|`ProductFamilyID`|Guid||Yes when ProductFamilySKU is not set||
|`ProductFamilySKU`|String||Yes when ProductFamilyID is not set||
|`ProductFamilyName`|String|||Readonly|
|`QuantitySettingsJSON`|String||Yes||
|`MapVariationsJSON`|String||Yes||
|`QuantityOptionName`|String|50|Yes||
|`CostingMethod`|String|||Readonly|
|`Unit`|String|||Readonly|
|`Position`|Integer||Yes||
|`SalePriceTier`|Integer|1 - 10|||

### Available Fields for Production BOM Resource
See <a href="#ProductionBOMResource"><b>Production BOM Resource Model</b></a>

### Available Fields for Production BOM Component
See <a href="#ProductionBOMComponent"><b>Production BOM Component Model</b></a>

### Available Fields for Production BOM Attachment
See <a href="#ProductionBOMAttachment"><b>Production BOM Attachment Model</b></a>

### Available Fields for Production BOM Note
See <a href="#ProductionBOMNote"><b>Production BOM Note Model</b></a>

### Available Fields for Production BOM Operation Link
See <a href="#ProductionBOMOperationLink"><b>Production BOM Operation Link Model</b></a>

### Available Fields for Production BOM InputProducts, OutputProducts, FinishedProducts
See <a href="#ProductionBOMOperationProduct"><b>Production BOM Operation Product Model</b></a>

<a id="get-production-productionbom-product-family-production-bom"></a>
### GET /production/productionBOM?ProductFamilyID={ProductFamilyID}&ReturnAttachmentsContent={ReturnAttachmentsContent}
+ Method will return all Production BOMs of specified product family.

Parameters:
- `ProductFamilyID` (required, guid): Identifier of the Product Family to return Production BOMs for

## Production Order

Path: `/production/order`
The Production Order resource allows Production Orders to be listed, viewed, created, updated and executed.

### Available Fields for Production Order
| Property              | Type      | Length    | Required  | Notes                                                         |
|:----------------------|-----------|-----------|-----------|---------------------------------------------------------------|
| `ProductionOrderID`   | Guid       |        |    Yes    | Unique identifier of Production Order. Required for Update action.             |
| `ProductID`            | Guid    |           |  Yes   | Unique identifier of Product.                                    |
| `ProductSKU`         | String    |           |        | Product SKU.                                                 |
| `ProductName`         | String    |           |        | Product Name.                          |
| `OrderNumber`         | String    |           |        | Production Order Number.                                |
| `LocationID`          | Guid    |           |  Yes   | Production Order Location ID.                                                |
| `LocationName`        | String    |           |           | Production Order Location Name.                                                   |
| `CostingMethod`        | String    |           |           | CostingMethod of Product (FIFO, FEFO etc.).                                                   |
| `WarehouseName`        | String    |           |           | Readonly.                                                   |
| `Unit`        | String    |           |           | Readonly.                                                   |
| `OrderStatus`      | String    |           |           | Production Order execution status (DRAFT, PLANNED, RELEASED, IN PROGRESS, COMPLETED, VOIDED). Readonly.                                         |
| `Status`             | String    |           |           | Production Order status (DRAFT, AUTHORIZED, RELEASED, VOIDED). Readonly.                                                 |
| `InstructionURL`        | String    |           |           | Readonly.                                                   |
| `SourceName`        | String    |           |           | Manual, Sale, SmartReorder.                                                   |
| `SourceTaskID`| Guid    |           |           |Obsolete. Unique identifier of Sale Task that produced the current Production Order record.                    |

<a id="put-production-order"></a>
### PUT /production/order?AllowRecalculateDates={AllowRecalculateDates}&AllowRecalculateCyclesAndQuantities={AllowRecalculateCyclesAndQuantities}
+ Method will update Production Order. Note: Few fields can be updated and only while Production Order is in Draft or Planned status.

Parameters:
- `AllowRecalculateDates` (optional, bool): Flag specifies if Capacity Calculation should be performed. If calculation is not successful then warning will be returned.
  - default: false
- `AllowRecalculateCyclesAndQuantities` (optional, bool): Flag specifies if Production Order Operations cycles and quantities can be recalculated in case of Production Order Quantity update.
  - default: false

Request body:

```json
{
  "ProductionOrderID": "fd5197cc-cf19-45cf-aafc-98e86647f941",
  "LocationID": "35c5646b-6a6d-4045-9512-04e1064a3e90",
  "Quantity": 5,
  "BOMVersion": 2
}
```

## Production Order List

Path: `/production/orderList`
Returns list of Production Order List Items

### Available Fields for Production Order List Item
| Property              | Type      | Length    | Required  | Notes                                                         |
|:----------------------|-----------|-----------|-----------|---------------------------------------------------------------|

| `ProductionOrderID`   | Guid       |        |        | Unique identifier of Production Order.                                             |
| `Type`              | String    |           |        | Type of the returned record. Available values are `O` - Production Order and `R` - Production Order Run.|
| `ProductID`            | Guid    |           |        | Unique identifier of Product.                                    |

| `Quantity`            | Decimal    |           |           | Production Order Quantity.                                                     |
| `StartDate`            | DateTime       |           |           | Production Order Start Date.                         |
| `ReleaseDate`            | DateTime       |           |           | Production Order Release Date.                         |

<a id="get-production-orderlist"></a>
### GET /production/orderList?Page={Page}&Limit={Limit}&Status={Status}&Search={Search}&LocationID={LocationID}&RequiredByDateFrom={RequiredByDateFrom}&RequiredByDateTo={RequiredByDateTo}&CompletionDateFrom={CompletionDateFrom}&CompletionDateTo={CompletionDateTo}&SourceTaskID={SourceTaskID}
+ Returns Production Orders and Production Runs according to provided filters.

Parameters:
- `Page` (optional, number): Page (Default: 1)
- `Limit` (optional, number): Specifies the page size for pagination. Default page size is 100 (Default: 100)
- `Status` (optional, string): Filter by status, value on of the list: AllButVoided, Draft, Planned, Released, InProgress, Completed (Default: not set)
- `Search` (optional, string): Only return Production Orders that have the provided text in Product Code or Product Name, Production Order Number, Tags, Comments, in Location name (Default: not set)
- `LocationID` (optional, uniqueidentifier): Only return Production Orders that have LocationID equal to provided value (Default: not set)
- `RequiredByDateFrom` (optional, DateTime): Only return Production Orders that have RequiredByDate field greater than the provided value Default: not set)
- `RequiredByDateTo` (optional, DateTime): Only return Production Orders that have RequiredByDate field less than the provided value (Default: not set)
- `CompletionDateFrom` (optional, DateTime): Only return Production Orders that have CompletionDate field greater than the provided value (Default: not set)
- `CompletionDateTo` (optional, DateTime): Only return Production Orders that have CompletionDate field less than the provided value (Default: not set)
- `SourceTaskID` (optional, uniqueidentifier): Only return Production Orders that are created as a result of execution a Sale Task with ID = SourceTaskID Default: not set)

Response 200:

## Production Run

| IN PROGRESS   |
| OPERATION_COMPLETED   |
| COMPLETED   |
| VOIDED   |

| IN PROGRESS   |

<a id="put-production-order-run"></a>
### PUT /production/order/run?ProductionOrderID={ProductionOrderID}&IncreaseOrderQuantity={IncreaseOrderQuantity}
+ Method will update Run.

Parameters:
- `ProductionOrderID` (required, guid): Production Order identifier
- `IncreaseOrderQuantity` (required, bool): Will increase order quantity if sum all run's quantity more then order quantity.

Request body:

```json
{
    "RunID": "a093ae70-c620-2318-c470-db45feb1ebf9"",
    "Quantity": 15.0000000000
}
```

## Resource List

Path: `/production/resourceList?Page={Page}&Limit={Limit}&Name={Name}&OnlyActive={OnlyActive}`
Get Resource List operation

<a id="get-production-resourcelist"></a>
### GET /production/resourceList?Page={Page}&Limit={Limit}&Name={Name}&OnlyActive={OnlyActive}
+ Method will return all resources.

Parameters:
- `Page` (optional, number): Page
  - default: 1
- `Limit` (optional, number): Specifies the page size for pagination. Default page size is 100.
  - default: 100
- `Name` (optional, string): Only return Resources that start with the specific Name or Code
- `OnlyActive` (optional, boolean): Only return active resources.
  - default: true

Response 200:

```json
{
"Resources": [
        {
            "ResourceID": "94f2bd01-fb4f-4c44-b679-0c700c1f1df9",
            "IsInfinite": false,
            "IsAllowAllCapacityUsage": false,
            "IsAvailableOnHolidays": false,
            "IsAvailableOnWeekends": false,
            "IsActive": true,
            "Code": "R-1",
            "Name": "Chef",
            "Tags": "",
            "ResourceType": "Machine",
            "CycleDuration": 2040
        },
    ]
}
```

## Resource

Path: `/production/resource?ResourceID={ResourceID}&IncludeAttachments={IncludeAttachments}`
Resource CRUD operations

<a id="ResourceTypeList"></a>

### Available Resource Types
|Type|Description|
|:-----|-----------|
|`Labor`||
|`Machine`||
|`Other`||

<a id="DayOfWeekList"></a>

### Available DayOfWeek values
|Value|Description|
|:-----|-----------|
|`Monday`||
|`Tuesday`||
|`Wednesday`||
|`Thursday`||
|`Friday`||
|`Saturday`||
|`Sunday`||

### Available Fields for Resource
| Property | Type           | Length | Required |Notes       |
|:-------|----------------------|---------|----------|----------|
| `ResourceID`  | Guid           |         | Yes* |   Required for PUT and DELETE, Ignored for POST operations       |
| `Code`  | String             | 50        | Yes* | Resource Code, required for PUT if there is no ResourceID     |
| `Name`  | String             | 512        | Yes* | Resource name, required for POST     |
| `ResourceType`  | String             |         |    Yes      | Possible values are <a href="#ResourceTypeList"><b>values</b></a>      |
| `CycleDuration`  | Int             |         |   Yes       |   In seconds, should be between 1 and 7776000        |
| `IsActive`  | Bool          |         |          | Default false           |
| `IsInfinite`  | Bool          |         |          | Default false           |
| `IsAllowAllCapacityUsage`  | Bool          |         |          | Default false           |
| `IsAvailableOnHolidays`  | Bool          |         |          | Default false           |
| `IsAvailableOnWeekends`  | Bool          |         |          | Default false           |
| `Tags`  | String          |    2000     |          |         |Comma separated|
| `ResourceCapacities`  | Array             |         |          | |
| `ResourceCosts`  | Array             |         |          | |
| `ResourceRemarks`  | Array             |         |          | |
| `ResourceAttachments`  | Array             |         |          | |

### Available Fields for ResourceCapacity
| Property | Type           | Length | Required |Notes       |
|:-------|----------------------|---------|----------|----------|
| `LocationID`  | Guid           |         | Yes |       |
| `LocationName`  | String             | 50        |  Yes*  | Required if there is no LocationID |
| `ResourceQuantity`  | Int             |         |  | Readonly    |
| `NonOperationalFrom`  | DateTime             |         |          | Nulluble      |
| `NonOperationalTo`  | DateTime             |         |          |   Nulluble        |
| `CustomWorkingDays`  | Array             |         |          | |
| `ResourceUnits`  | Array             |         |          | |

### Available Fields for CustomWorkingDay
| Property | Type           | Length | Required |Notes       |
|:-------|----------------------|---------|----------|----------|
| `DayOfWeek`  | String           |         | Yes |   Possible values are <a href="#DayOfWeekList"><b>values</b></a>   |
| `StartTime`  | Short             |         |  Yes*  | Range 0 - 1440 |
| `EndTime`  | Short             |         |  Yes*  | Range 0 - 1440 |
| `BreakStartTime`  | Short             |         |    | Range 0 - 1440 |
| `BreakEndTime`  | Short             |         |    | Range 0 - 1440 |
|`Capacity`|Int | | | Readonly  |

### Available Fields for ResourceUnit
| Property | Type           | Length | Required |Notes       |
|:-------|----------------------|---------|----------|----------|
| `Name`  | String           |    256     | Yes | For resource with type = `Labor`, it must be Email of the registered user. Otherwise any name  |
| `NonOperationalFrom`  | DateTime             |         |   | Nullable|
| `NonOperationalTo`  | DateTime             |         |    | Nullable |
| `OperationalFrom`  | DateTime             |         |   | Nullable|
| `OperationalTo`  | DateTime             |         |    | Nullable |

### Available Fields for ResourceCost
| Property | Type           | Length | Required |Notes       |
|:-------|----------------------|---------|----------|----------|
| `ResourceCostID`  | Guid           |         |  | Readonly  |
| `ProductID`  | Guid             |         | Yes  | Identifier of service product|
| `AccountCode`  | String             |    50     | Yes   | Expense Account |
| `Cost`  | Decimal             |         |   | Readonly|
| `PriceTier`  | Int             |         |  Yes  | Range 1-10 |
| `PlannedDowntimeCost`  | Decimal             |         |   | Readonly|
| `PlannedDowntimePriceTier`  | Int             |         |   | Nullable. Range 1-10 |
| `NotPlannedDowntimeCost`  | Decimal             |         |   | Readonly|
| `NotPlannedDowntimePriceTier`  | Int             |         |    | Nullable. Range 1-10 |

### Available Fields for ResourceRemark
| Property | Type           | Length | Required |Notes       |
|:-------|----------------------|---------|----------|----------|
| `RemarkID`  | Guid           |         |  | Readonly  |
| `Remark`  | String             |    1024     | Yes   | |
| `CreatedDate`  | DateTime             |         |    | Readonly |

### Available Fields for ResourceAttachment
| Property | Type           | Length | Required |Notes       |
|:-------|----------------------|---------|----------|----------|
| `AttachmentID`  | Guid           |         |  | Readonly  |
| `FileName`  | String             |    256     | Yes  | |
| `Date`  | DateTime             |         |    | Readonly |
| `ContentType`  | String             | 256        |   | Readonly|
| `Content`  | String             |   32 Mb      |  Yes  | Base64 encoded string |

## Suspend Reason

Path: `/production/suspendReason`
Suspend Reason CRUD operations

<a id="get-production-suspendreason"></a>
### GET /production/suspendReason?Page={Page}&Limit={Limit}&WorkcenterID={WorkcenterID}
+ Method will return all suspend reasons.

Parameters:
- `Page` (optional, number): Page
  - default: 1
- `Limit` (optional, number): Specifies the page size for pagination. Default page size is 100.
  - default: 100
- `WorkcenterID` (optional, guid): Only return suspend reasons with specified work center.
  - default: null

Response 200:

```json
{
"SuspendReasons": [
        {
            "SuspendReasonID": "94f2bd01-fb4f-4c44-b679-0c700c1f1df9",
            "Reason": "some text",
            "Workcenters":[
                "94f2bd01-fb4f-4c44-b679-0c700c1f1df1",
                "94f2bd01-fb4f-4c44-b679-0c700c1f1df2"
            ]
        },
    ]
}
```

<a id="put-production-suspendreason"></a>
### PUT /production/suspendReason
+ Workcenters do not support modifying. Only creation and deletion.

### Available Fields for SuspendReason
| Property | Type           | Length | Required |Notes       |
|:-------|----------------------|---------|----------|----------|
| `SuspendReasonID`  | Guid           |         | Yes* | If it is empty, then will add new Suspend Reason, otherwise it will be modified |
| `Reason`  | String             |         | Yes*  | Only for new entity |
| `Workcenters`  | Guid Array             |         |    |  |

Request body:

```json
 {
    "Reason": "some new text",
    "Workcenters":[
        "94f2bd01-fb4f-4c44-b679-0c700c1f1df1",
        "94f2bd01-fb4f-4c44-b679-0c700c1f1df2"
    ]
},
```

Response 200:

```json
{
  "SuspendReasonID": "94f2bd01-fb4f-4c44-b679-0c700c1f1df9",
  "Reason": "some new text",
  "Workcenters": [
    "94f2bd01-fb4f-4c44-b679-0c700c1f1df1",
    "94f2bd01-fb4f-4c44-b679-0c700c1f1df2"
  ]
}
```

## Work Centers

Path: `/production/workcenters`
The Workcenter resource allows Workcenters to be listed, viewed, created, and updated. The Workcenter is a station where work is being carried out within a Shopfloor.

### Available Fields for WorkCenter
|Property|Type|Length|Required|Notes|
|:-------|----|------|--------|-----|
|`WorkCenterID`|Guid||Yes|Identifier of a Workcenter|
|`Code`|String|256|Yes||
|`Name`|String|256|Yes||
|`IsActive`|Boolean||Yes||
|`IsCoMan`|Boolean||Yes||
|`IsCoManPurchase`|Boolean||Yes||
|`SupplierID`|Guid||Yes*|Is required when IsCoMan = true or IsCoMan = true and IsCoManPurchase = true.|
|`SupplierName`|String||||
|`CoManProcurementType`|String|10|Yes*|It may be 'Transfer' or 'Buysell' or 'Purchase'. Required for Co-man workcenters only.|
|`WorkCenterLocations`|<a href="#WorkCenterLocation"><b>[] WorkCenter Location Model</b></a>|||Empty when components are picked directly from a shopfloor location.|
|`WorkCenterSuppliers`|<a href="#WorkCenterSupplier"><b>[] WorkCenter Supplier Model</b></a>||Yes*|Required when IsCoMan = false and IsCoManPurchase = true|

### Available Fields for WorkCenter Location <a id="WorkCenterLocation"></a>
|Property|Type|Length|Required|Notes|
|:-------|----|------|--------|-----|
|`ID`|Guid||Yes|Identifier of a WorkCenter Location|
|`LocationID`|Guid||Yes|Can be LocationID or BinID if current location is a Bin|
|`Type`|String|256|Yes|Consumption, Output|
|`ParentLocationID`|Guid|||Parent location ID when current location is Bin|
|`LocationName`|String||Yes||

### Available Fields for WorkCenter Supplier <a id="WorkCenterSupplier"></a>
|Property|Type|Length|Required|Notes|
|:-------|----|------|--------|-----|
|`SupplierID`|Guid||Yes*|Is required when SupplierName is empty.|
|`SupplierName`|String||Yes*|Is required if SupplierID is empty|

<a id="get-production-workcenters"></a>
### GET /production/workcenters?Page={Page}&Limit={Limit}&Name={Name}
+ Method will return all workcenters.

Parameters:
- `Page` (optional, number): Page
  - default: 1
- `Limit` (optional, number): Specifies the page size for pagination. Default page size is 100.
  - default: 100
- `Name` (optional, string): Only return WorkCenters that start with the specific Name

Response 200:

```json
{
    "Workcenters": [
    {
        "WorkCenterID": "e180613b-1a63-41c3-a1f3-1316319e60a7",
        "Code": "API Test",
        "Name": "Workcenter test for API",
        "IsActive": true,
        "IsCoMan": true,
        "IsCoManPurchase": false,
        "SupplierID": "f9d6abe7-39b5-4fc1-a7aa-b61d2dc933e9",
        "SupplierName": "Tom the Supplier",

                "LocationID": "d1a2cfd2-93b8-4c2f-aeec-a392f905466f",
                "LocationName": "BFBin",

                "ParentLocationName": null,
                "Type": "Consumption"
            }
        ],
        "CoManProcurementType": "Transfer",
        "WorkCenterSuppliers": [],
    }
}
```
